desc: a rough Korean mountain bandit of the Samhan era (1st century): a lean, sun-browned man in his thirties with a scruffy beard, a dark cloth headband, a short hemp jacket with a tattered fur vest, baggy trousers tied at the ankles, straw sandals, a rope belt with a small pouch
armor: NO metal armor, NO helmet, NO mask (no ninja look).
hold: ONE heavy wooden club with an iron-banded head in his right hand

desc: the burly Korean mountain-bandit chief of the Samhan era: a big barrel-chested man with a wild black beard and topknot, a bear-fur cloak over a bare chest, a wide leather belt with bronze plates, baggy trousers, leather boots
armor: NO helmet, NO mask, NO Chinese or Japanese armor.
hold: ONE huge two-handed iron battle axe
